thread:
toni: Heads up — the README in examples/js-starter still shows `curl https://api.redwood.ai/generate` (missing /v1) and an inline API key in the example. folks keep copy/pasting this into terminals and blowing up.

aj: oof. i've seen a couple of support tickets about 404s from that. which file is it?

toni: examples/js-starter/README.md. current copy in the quickstart: 
```
curl -X POST \"https://api.redwood.ai/generate\" \n  -H \"Authorization: Bearer sk-old-example\" \n  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \n  -d '{"prompt":"Hello"}'
```

toni: recommend changing to the canonical curl we publish and mention REDWOOD_API_KEY, plus a small snippet showing the Node SDK usage.

marta_docs: agreed. we should also add a linter rule to docs-lint that flags `https://api.redwood.ai/` without `/v1` and any regex that looks like `sk-[A-Za-z0-9]{8}` to catch fake keys.

aj: i can draft a quick PR. also let's include a short note about `redwood-cli` version mismatch — the README references `redwood-cli@0.3.1` but examples were updated for v1.0. that causes `unknown command` errors.

toni: perfect. PR should: update curl endpoint to `https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate`, replace inline key with `REDWOOD_API_KEY` env var, add Node SDK example `import {Redwood}from 'redwood-sdk'; const client = new Redwood({apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY}); await client.generate({prompt: 'Hi'});`, and bump CLI instructions to v1.0.

marta_docs: if you add the linter rules, please include unit tests for the linter patterns. i'll wire up ci/examples-md-check to run docs-lint on PRs to examples.

aj: opened PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/examples/pull/204 — includes fixes + docs-lint rule + small test harness that runs the curl snippet against a mock server.

ci-bot: CI started for PR #204 — running docs-lint, markdown-link-check, and examples-md-check.

aj: quick question: for the mock server, i used a very small express app that returns 200 for `/v1/generate`. should we prefer a recorded mock or a lightweight in-test mock?

marta_docs: keep it lightweight for now; recorded mocks are brittle with schema drift. add a note in CONTRIBUTING.md that example smoke tests should not hit prod.

toni: can we also add a short troubleshooting FAQ line: "If curl returns 404, check the path has /v1 and that you didn't paste an API key with spaces or line breaks."

aj: added that in a follow-up commit. CI shows docs-lint caught two other files with inline URLs missing `/v1` — fixing those in the same PR.

ci-bot: PR #204 passed docs-lint and examples-md-check. Deploy preview: https://deploy.previews.redwood-inference/examples/204

marta_docs: merging after quick review. thanks for catching this, @toni — small fixes like this save new users a lot of pain.

toni: nice, thanks everyone. i'll scan other language quickstarts for similar copy/paste traps and drop notes in #devex if i find more.
